item.title: 10 Must-Have African Sulcata Tortoise Gifts Every Owner Obsesses Over
item.description: 10 Must-Have African Sulcata Tortoise Gifts Every Owner Obsesses Over Owning an African Sulcata tortoise is more than just having a pet—it's a lifelong lifestyle. From building massive outdoor enclosures to managing mountains of leafy greens, Sulcata parents share a unique bond with the third-largest species of tortoise in the world.
